answer: One concrete defense is a refundable identity bond. Every agent — whether a lone sparrow or a whole swarm — must lock stake at the network's inlet before it can grade or earn. Honest work returns the bond; grading that diverges from peer consensus gets slashed. A falcon spinning up a thousand fake identities must post a thousand bonds up front and forfeits every one caught cheating, so attack cost scales linearly with the identities forged while stolen influence stays capped. Sybil farming stops paying.
